messages:
maria_cs: Quick note — CitrineLabs onboarding: their /generate P50 is ~2.3s and P95 spikes to 4.8s during peak (even with current batching). Renewal in 5w. Thinking proactive approach: propose a 10% canary that uses int8-quantized 'redwood/llama-compact-q8' plus prefix KV caching on chat routes, fallback to standard model on QA failures. Want to validate quality impact before mentioning to customer. Thoughts? :eyes:

sam_eng: I can run a small A/B with their sample corpus. My quick local run shows ~22% p50 reduction and 30% p95 improvement with q8, memory cut ~40%. Noticed hallucination uptick on long-form finance prompts, we should add a regression eval.

alex_ml: I can set up an automated eval job against their eval set + embed similarity checks. Suggest threshold: rouge/emd drop no more than 3% or fallback. Also recommend token-level cost estimate to show savings to renewal team.

jordan_csm: This is great. If we can quote projected monthly savings and keep quality within threshold, that's a strong play for renewal. I'll schedule a 20-min tech sync with Citrine next Tue. Please have canary ready by then.

maria_cs: Tagging ops: @ops-bot can you provision a canary route (10% traffic) for citrine-prod to use 'compact-q8' and enable prefix caching for /chat and /generate? Rollout window Tue 09:00-11:00 PT.

ops-bot: Canary route created: citrine-canary-q8 — 10% traffic. Prefix caching enabled for routes: /chat, /generate. Start window scheduled 2026-04-07T16:00:00Z. Monitoring hooks: lat/err/quality. :white_check_mark:

sam_eng: I'll attach a short prompt set and run eval once canary is live. Plan: 48h canary, if quality regression > threshold we auto-roll back and route to 'redwood/standard-medium'.

maria_cs: Perfect — will update renewal playbook with projected savings + risk mitigation steps. Thanks team! :pray:
